description: This file defines a utility function `resolveChannelAccountConfigBasePath` that constructs a configuration path prefix for a specified channel account, falling back to the channel section if the account-specific configuration is not present. It imports types from an external config module and manipulates nested configuration objects.

methods.name: export function resolveChannelAccountConfigBasePath(params: { resolveChannelAccountConfigBasePath
methods.description: Constructs and returns a configuration path prefix string for a given channel account, prioritizing account-specific configuration if it exists.

ctags.name: accounts
ctags.pattern: /^  const accounts = channelSection?.accounts as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;$/

ctags.name: channelSection
ctags.pattern: /^  const channelSection = channels?.[params.channelKey] as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;$/

ctags.name: channels
ctags.pattern: /^  const channels = params.cfg.channels as unknown as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;$/
